rationale: Record a view-input and bridge change that crosses the render-assets-and-backends family through its broad core/view and packages/pulp-react selectors. Scripted editors can now ask whether they run in a DAW host or the standalone (a host-kind query on the widget bridge, with regenerated pulp-react global and mock typings), a wheel or pinch over an open overlay is routed to that overlay and blocked outside a modal one via a read-only route_passive_pointer verb, and a hidden popover no longer holds keyboard focus. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, render backend, asset, codegen output, fixture or threshold changes, and nothing is painted differently. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
